business_summary: Henan Shuanghui Investment & Development Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the slaughtering, processing, and selling of meat products in China. The company offers canned and frozen meat; pre-packaged cooked meat, including halal food; edible animal fats/lard; aquatic products, such as ready-to-eat surimi products; feed; PVDC casing films and color prints, PVDC resin powder, offset cartons, and food packaging materials, and other packaging materials; seasonings, food additives, and compound food additives; technical consulting; warehousing; catering services and management; essences for osteoarthritis; financial services, including accounts receivable factoring and financing; heat and electricity; sodium lactate; and other supporting services. It is also involved in the breeding and slaughtering of livestock and poultry; acquisition of agricultural and sideline products; sales of egg and chemical products; food industry and business investment; sales and trade agency; rolling, processing, and sales of aluminum; self-operated and agency import and export business; information product research and development; e-commerce; catering investment management; technology development; and technical services. The company sells its products through sales terminals. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Luohe, China. Henan Shuanghui Investment & Development Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Rotary Vortex Limited.
